seo.description: A timeline of a three-month trip across Japan - notes, photos, video and a map, day by day.

search.heading: Results for “{query}”
search.empty: Nothing found. Try a different query.
search.emptyMedia: No photos or videos match this query.
search.expandDay: Show the rest of this day

day.noNote: No note has been written for this day yet.
day.noCoordinates: None of this day's files have coordinates.
day.notFound: This day is not part of the timeline.

map.title: Trip map
map.noPoints: No media with coordinates in the selected range.
map.pickRange: Pick a first day in the calendar, then a last one - the map keeps only that stretch of the route.
map.pickEnd: Now pick the second day. If it falls before the first, the two ends swap over.

media.hiddenNoShare: This file is hidden - there is no link to share
media.hiddenSelectionNoShare: All selected files are hidden - there is no link to share

language.label: Language
language.fallbackNotice: No translation for the selected language - showing the original.

richText.insertMediaHint: Insert a reference to files of this page by ID: [media=ID]Caption[/media]. Several files go in one reference, ids split by commas with no spaces.
richText.pickMediaHint: Pick files in the grid below: one fills the reference outright, several ask to be confirmed. Typing cancels this.
richText.confirmPickHint: The selected files are written into the reference. Confirm when the set is right.
richText.mediaMissingHint: There is no file with this ID here - it was deleted or the ID is wrong.

admin.title: Pending
admin.allDone: Everything is filled in - nothing here.
admin.deleteConfirmMany: Delete {count} file? This cannot be undone. | Delete {count} files? This cannot be undone.

editor.bulkHint: Fields are prefilled from the first selected file with content. Only what you change is sent - anything left alone stays as each file had it.
editor.title: Title
editor.coordinatesHint: Click the map to drop a pin
editor.approvedHint: Approved files are published for visitors. A hidden file is not shown even when approved.
editor.selectMore: Press and drag across files to select several
editor.autoTranslateHint: On save the backend fills the empty languages by translating the one you wrote.
editor.translationReview: Machine translation filled in - review the other languages before leaving.
editor.mapHint: Click the map to drop a pin. The marker can be dragged.
editor.neighborPoints: Grey pins are files already placed on this day and the ones either side, to go by
editor.favorite: Featured - show on the front page
editor.favoriteHint: Featured files are shown on the front page.
editor.hidden: Hide - keep out of public view
editor.hiddenHint: The file stays visible to you, but not in the day, the search, or behind a link.
editor.marksBulkNote: The marks apply to every selected file - both when set and when taken off.
editor.autoTranslateBulkWarning: Translating sends the text of every filled language to all selected files, changed or not.
editor.draftRestored: An unsaved draft has been restored.
editor.mixedHint: A dash means the selected files disagree. Pressing it settles the mark for all of them; a mark left alone is not sent.
editor.pasteHint: Coordinates copied from Google Maps can be pasted here with Ctrl+V.
editor.clearPointHint: Right-click the pin to take it off.

footer.aboutText: A personal timeline of a three-month trip across Japan: notes, photos and points on the map.
footer.gridReadonlyHint: A safety mode that prevents accidental presses on the grid's editing buttons

errors.network: The server is unreachable. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unauthorized: You need to sign in as editor.

tags.title: Tags
tags.filterPlaceholder: A caption or an alias, in any language…
tags.caption: Caption
tags.captionsHint: What a visitor sees. One per language, and all three are required.
tags.captionsMissing: Fill in a caption for all three languages.
tags.aliasesHint: For searching only: a visitor is found by them, and they never reach the screen.
tags.slugHint: The internal name. Shown nowhere, but it has to be unique.
tags.similarHint: Check whether one of these is the same thing. Click to take it instead of coining a new one.
tags.pickHint: Tags are picked from the dictionary. Matches captions and aliases in all three languages.
tags.unknownIds: {count} more tag is not in the dictionary | {count} more tags are not in the dictionary
tags.bulkHint: Changing the tags overwrites them on every selected file. Left alone, each file keeps its own.
tags.seedLabel: What word are we starting from?
tags.seedHint: One word, in any language. Captions for all three languages, aliases and a slug are proposed from it - and have to be read before saving.
tags.needCaptionFirst: Write a caption in at least one language first.
tags.similarUse: Take this tag instead of a new one
tags.similarInspect: Show this tag in the list - the draft is kept
tags.unresolved: These tags could not be resolved: {tags}. Reload the page and try again.

similar.title: Similar photos
similar.unavailable: No similarity data for this file.
similar.chooseThrough: Choose everything down to this one
similar.noTags: Tag this photo first - its tags are what the chosen ones get.
similar.applied: Tags applied to {count} photo | Tags applied to {count} photos
similar.hint: The percentage is how alike. Above 95% is usually the next frame of a series, 80-95% the same place, below 70% is mostly unrelated.
similar.pickTags: Choose tags, then select the photos to receive them.
similar.filtered: {count} hidden - they already carry the chosen tags.
similar.allTagged: Every similar file already carries the chosen tags.

collect.title: Collecting a tag
collect.subtitle: A second pass over the archive - by subject rather than by day.
collect.pickTag: Choose a tag to find candidates for.
collect.tooFewSeeds: Mark at least {min} photos with this tag by hand to switch suggestions on. Marked so far: {count}.
collect.hint: Sorted by likeness. Hover a frame to choose everything down to it, or to open it full screen.
collect.applied: Tag applied to {count} photo | Tag applied to {count} photos

bulkTag.title: Add tags to {count} files
bulkTag.hint: The tags are added to the selected files; whatever else they carry stays. To replace the set outright, edit the selection instead.
bulkTag.applied: Tags added to {count} file | Tags added to {count} files
